recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if a future work group reintroduces DataElement or specifically asks to change active examples that reference external LOINC DataElement URLs.
issue_request: FHIR-6923 asked to change a DataElement max count from 0..1 to 0..* for DSTU1; the Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution says the request was presumed to mean Identifier and that Identifier had already been made 0..* by another change request.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-6923 was found. Historical source/dataelement/dataelement-spreadsheet.xml before DataElement removal already contained DataElement.identifier with cardinality 0..*, matching the recorded Jira resolution.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini has DataElement only in commented resource, workgroup, TLA, and R2 rename entries and no active DataElement build entry. The source/dataelement files were removed in the 2021 new-build-core/R4B source rework. FHIR-7109 is the same ballot request but is marked Duplicate. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No current FHIR-core source edit is needed because the historically relevant cardinality was already correct and the DataElement resource is out of the current build scope.

related_jiras.note: Same 2015May DataElement max-count request, marked Duplicate, so it was used as background rather than decided independently.
